title: Dream Jail. Are we in it?

classification.theory_summary: Speculates that "mallworld" is a kind of "dream jail" and asks if dreamers are placed there because they are a threat.
classification.question_topic: Whether Mall World is a "dream jail" and why dreamers might be placed there

meta.final_emotion: pure fear / terrified out of my mind (during the episode described)
meta.author_theory: Asks if "we" are being placed in "mallworld" because "we are a threat"; asks what "they" are afraid of; asks if dreamers have "power of GODS".

interactions.description: During sleep paralysis, the dreamer "trained" themself to overcome the paralysis part and "fight the 'demon'" by "kicking and waving my arms (at least in my mind, in my dreams)" with the goal of overriding paralysis and ending the terror.

entities_involved.description: Referred to as a "demon" during sleep paralysis episodes (no physical details given).

interactions.description: One night the dreamer "finally broke through paralysis" and saw "this weird shape" interpreted as "some kind of face"; "maybe digital in nature"; "More like a moving painting."

entities_involved.description: A "weird shape" like "some kind of face"; "maybe digital"; "like a moving painting."

interactions.description: After breaking through paralysis, the dreamer apparently "screamed bloody murder" and "burst through my door into the hallway still screaming until I was stopped."

entities_involved.description: Unspecified person(s) who "stopped" the dreamer in the hallway.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post contains sleep paralysis/lucid-dreaming narrative and a claim of subsequent recurring "mallworld" dreams, but provides no describable Mall World locations or spatial layout. Two implied waking/near-waking settings (bedroom/doorway and hallway) were referenced only as part of the episode; they were not described as Mall World.
